A [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Color/Legends|Green]]-skinned '''Trandoshan''' was a member of the [[Black Heth]] criminal gang<ref name="SW:OW" /> in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].<ref name="Date" /> He was part of a group of thugs who took control of [[Elcor Station]] in the [[Coruscant Underworld/Legends|Coruscant underworld]]. He carried a large [[Mace (weapon)/Legends|mace]] at that time. He [[Skirmishes on Coruscant|fought]] the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] on top of a hovertrain and [[Death/Legends|died]] in the struggle. Kenobi then cleared a piece of debris blocking the Elcor train, and returned to the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]].<ref name="SW:OW" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Trandoshan gang member appears in the [[2001]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars: Obi-Wan (video game)|''Star Wars: Obi-Wan'']]. He serves as the boss of the first level.
